expected_value_creation: A provider-neutral intake protocol makes imported matched-run evidence traceable and routes weak evidence to governance before corpus claims.
beneficiary: QIF maintainers, independent evaluators, and organizations adopting QIF Skills
supporting_evidence: v0.8.14 already provides matched-run evaluation but intentionally leaves committed runs example-only.
2026 Skill research identifies portability, dependency identity, and provenance as unresolved trust problems.
success_criteria: Every imported run resolves source, executor, client/environment, Skill digest, input/transcript digest, custody events, and attestation.
Corpus readiness is reproducible and cannot become verified when evidence is example-only, conflicted, stale, or custody-incomplete.
